violet.why: Entry is the countable flower (EN 'Violet/Violets'); FR left the masculine colour word 'Violet'. Larousse: the flower is 'violette' n.f.; 'violet' is only the colour/adjectif.

penguin.why: Singular is 'Manchot' (penguin); plural wrongly held 'Pingouins' (a different animal, the auk). Larousse: manchot n.m. -> manchots.

yak.why: Singular is 'Yak'; plural must agree -> 'Yaks'. 'Yacks' is the plural of the variant spelling 'yack'. Larousse gives 'yack ou yak', plural regular +s.

violet.why: Flower plural agrees with corrected singular 'violette' (n.f.) -> 'violettes'.

squash.why: Larousse: 'courge' is nom feminin (la courge). cur coded masculine.

violet.why: Flower 'violette' is nom feminin; cur held the masculine colour word.
